name: Hip opener
description: A floor routine for stiff hips that works rotation, the hip flexors and the inner thighs. Good after a day of sitting or before squats.

items.cue: Loosen up with big, slow circles both ways.
Sit tall and hinge over the front shin.
Switch knees side to side slowly, use your hands if needed.
Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the back glute.
Both hands inside the front foot, let the hips sink.
Keep the hips square and rest on your forearms if you can.
Knees wide, ankles in line with knees, push the hips back gently.
Soles together, sit tall and let the knees drop.
Pull the knees toward the armpits and rock gently.
Draw the knee toward the opposite shoulder.
